_notes: ST LSM6DS3 / LSM6DS33 (WHO_AM_I 0x69), FIFO-enabled 6-axis IMU (Axiom). STOP_ON_FTH on this part is CTRL4_C (0x13) bit 0, so init writes FIFO_CTRL4 = 0x00 and CTRL4_C = 0x01 (measured on Axiom018: the FIFO then stops at the 1020-word threshold). The 0x6A parts are LSM6DS3TRC. Two-phase I2C read: first reads FIFO_STATUS1-4 (word count), then reads only the required FIFO data bytes from 0x3E. FIFO_PATTERN (STATUS3/4) used to skip to next aligned group boundary before decoding. Each sample = 6 words (gx,gy,gz,ax,ay,az). FIFO depth is limited to the 1020-word watermark (FIFO_CTRL1/2) by STOP_ON_FTH, so DIFF_FIFO can never wrap to 0 (with an unlimited depth a host pause of >6.6 s filled the 4096-word FIFO, the count read 0 and the {$0.w12} poll read nothing forever - devdocs/lsm6ds-fifo-full-deadlock.md). The _conf.rate entries keep the watermark. Gyro 70 mdps/LSB at 2000 dps.

rsao.note: bench (Axiom018, 2026-10-27, an LSM6DS33 at 0x6A, FIFO streaming): 0x99 is past the register map (bit 7 isn't ignored - 0x19 reads 0x38) and the read returns zeros; FIFO_CTRL1-5, CTRL1_XL-CTRL10_C, MASTER_CONFIG and the interrupt configuration (0x58-0x5E) unchanged, and the FIFO carried on at the 104 Hz rate. Its addresses are in Axiom's excluded RSAO range anyway

c.c: int W=((buf[1]&0x0F)<<8)|buf[0];int P=((buf[3]&0x03)<<8)|buf[2];int skip=(6-P%6)%6;int N=(W-skip)/6;int maxN=(240-skip*2)/12;if(N>maxN){N=maxN;}if(N<1){N=0;}int k=4+skip*2;int i=0;while(i<N){out.gx=(buf[k+1]<<8)|buf[k];out.gy=(buf[k+3]<<8)|buf[k+2];out.gz=(buf[k+5]<<8)|buf[k+4];out.ax=(buf[k+7]<<8)|buf[k+6];out.ay=(buf[k+9]<<8)|buf[k+8];out.az=(buf[k+11]<<8)|buf[k+10];k+=12;i++;next;}
